blocks.x: [laughs] Okay, now let‘s talk about y our last name ―Young,‖ because we‘re going to be talking about Trummy Young and you‘re going to be leaving Jimmy Lunceford to go join Lester and Lee Young. Are you related to them, do you know of any relation, direct relation or indirect relation?
No, I‘m not related to Lee Young, I‘m not, Lee Young and Lester Young are brothers. And I‘m not related to Tremor Young. Yeah, Lester young‘s I‘m not related to them in any way. No kind of way.
